messages:
Mia: Quick ping — PR 43721 (feat/render-cache): CI failing only on integration-shard7, looks like nondet snapshot test. CI: https://ci.redwood.dev/43721
Mia: Failing test: RenderCacheTest.should_handle-ttl-expiry
Mia: Failing output:
```
AssertionError: expected 42 to equal 43
at RenderCacheTest.scala:78
-- snapshot diff:
- 42
+ 43
```
Leo: ack. Any local repro?
Mia: tried `./gradlew :eng:integrationTest -t --tests RenderCacheTest*` on mac and linux, can't repro locally.
ci-bot: [build 43721] integration-shard7 failed: test RenderCacheTest.should_handle-ttl-expiry (flaky likely) :eyes:
Sam: is this a snapshot mismatch or real behavior regression?
Mia: looks like snapshot drift — the snapshot value increments nondeterministically on slow test timing. Happens under heavy load in shard7.
Olivia: can we rerun targeted shard? will that unblock merge?
Sam: need +1 to rerun — policy requires reviewer approval for reruns after 2 failures.
Raj: let's hold merge until we confirm it's flaky. Proposal:
- targeted rerun of shard7
- if fails again, add debug logs and run a 10x local loop with concurrency emulation
- if consistent, either fix test timing or quarantine with flaky tag
Olivia: +1 to rerun
Leo: +1 to debug loop. If we can't repro but CI keeps failing, quarantine is fine short-term.
Mia: thanks — triggering targeted rerun now @ci-bot
ci-bot: triggered targeted rerun: https://ci.redwood.dev/43721/targeted/shard7
Mia: note: if rerun passes, still planning to add tighter timing assertion and a small sleep in test to stabilize
Sam: also consider adding a metric to catch this in nightly smoke
Raj: agreed — please add an issue and link in PR if you quarantine
Mia: created issue #5126 and linked in PR. will update after rerun.
Mia: edit: rerun passed (green) — looks intermittent. leaving merge hold for 30m to watch telemetry :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Leo: if it stays green, we can merge after tests are stable. thx all
Olivia: thx, lgtm for rerun
Sam: leaving comment on PR to avoid surprise snapshot update
Mia: will follow up with PR comment + link to issue
Raj: thumbs up. If it flakes again, ping me and I'll run a bisect on the infra side.
